product_contract.outcome: The target project receives only approved methodology assets and a governed skill discovery process.
acceptance_steps: The preflight plan identifies every target conflict before copying.
External skills remain non-callable until review and registration are complete.
The project index identifies its technology profile and scan limits.
non_goals: This onboarding does not replace project runtime, database, authorization, or release evidence.
This onboarding does not overwrite project-owned assets by default.

truth_owner: The target project's authoritative rules, runtime, data model, and project-owner integration decision.

out_of_scope: Unrelated application source, database migrations, production configuration, and automatic deletion of project assets.
scope.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the preflight plan and restore only explicit task-owned additions or reviewed file-level backups.

test_strategy.public_seam: Project onboarding CLI preflight, candidate governance report, and methodology audit.
test_strategy.rationale: The delivery changes governance assets and is proven by deterministic CLI reports and focused regression tests.

final_proofs.claim: The onboarding workflow detects technology, preserves conflicts, and keeps candidates non-callable.
Activated methodology assets remain structurally valid.

standards_truth.evidence: Awaiting scoped diff and governance review.

product_spec.evidence: Awaiting confirmation against adoption outcome and non-goals.
